verdict.rationale: The Job APIs let you trigger processing runs as jobs, monitor their status, download results, and inspect failed files, which covers async execution with status polling. Transform quickstarts also describe creating jobs to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed files. Nothing in the evidence mentions completion webhooks or callbacks, so a pipeline must poll; missing for 10: completion webhooks/callback notifications, explicit documentation of the polling flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
